_comment: Explicit source-host allowlist for promotion/financing evidence URLs. Validation fails closed: source-backed claims error when their URL host is not listed here (web.archive.org captures are checked against their embedded target host). Narrow by design — add hosts deliberately, never wildcard. etail.mysynchrony.com may be added only if an approved stable partner link is supplied. priceSourceHosts (Phase 2.1) is the canonical allowlist for CURRENT retail price evidence only: first-party retailer pages. No lender pages, no archive captures, no image CDNs (linqcdn.avbportal.com is deliberately absent).
